articles.author: Lallalit Srijandorn
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump said that his administration is continuing negotiations with India to address trade barriers between the two countries, Reuters reported late Tuesday.
articles.title: US President Donald Trump says trade negotiations with India are still continuing

articles.author: FXStreet Team
articles.summary: China’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) declined 0.4% in August from a year ago after arriving at 0% in July, the National Bureau of Statistics of China reported on Wednesday. The market consensus was for -0.2% in the reported period.
articles.title: Breaking: China’s CPI inflation falls 0.4% YoY in August vs. -0.2% expected

articles.author: Joshua Gibson
articles.summary: GBP/USD briefly touched a four-week peak on Tuesday, testing chart territory north of 1.3550 before getting dragged back into the low side, snapping a two-day winstreak and putting Cable back on track for a decline to the 1.3500 handle.
articles.title: GBP/USD reverses gains ahead of US inflation figures

articles.author: Lallalit Srijandorn
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump has urged the European Union (EU) to impose 100% tariffs on Chinese and Indian goods in an effort to pressure Russian President Vladimir Putin, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday.
articles.title: US President Donald Trump urges EU to impose 100% tariffs on China, India to pressure Russia
